image_prompt.text: Touchlines and goal lines drawn as a detection perimeter so play resets the moment the ball crosses out
Centre circle kickoff spot and goal-kick positions the ball resets to
Two normal-sized goal mouths at opposite ends, drawn as goals and registering a score when the ball crosses the line
Painted pitch markings - centre circle, penalty areas, corner arcs
Tiered stands filled with crowds framing the pitch, giving the stadium scale and enclosing the map
A lobby you arrive in, with physical boxes labelled 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, 4v4 and 5v5 that players walk into to join a match
Spain and France team dressing - kits, flags and banners around the ground

layout_placement.text: Out-of-play detection around the whole pitch perimeter
Scoring volumes inside each goal mouth
Five mode-select volumes in the lobby, one per team size, each routing to a match

notes: The prompt contradicts itself: it opens with 'real players no bots no AI' and then specifies an AI goalkeeper for 1v1 and an AI-or-human goalkeeper choice for 2v2 through 5v5. The later, more specific statement was taken as the intent.
Team sizes run from 1v1 to 5v5 on the same pitch. A regulation field sized for 5v5 plays very differently at 1v1 and the handoff has no way to say the pitch scales or does not.
Everything about platform support, controller mapping and camera is outside layout and was not carried into the geometry.
spectator-bleachers is the source of the tiered route - stepped seating is relief with no overhang, so the stand height has to be captured or the stadium builds flat.

open_questions.ask: Full regulation pitch, or a smaller arcade-sized one that suits 1v1 as well as 5v5?
Is the lobby part of the same map as the pitch, or a separate place the mode boxes teleport out of?
A real-looking stadium, or something more stylized?

theme: Modern Urban - contemporary realistic stadium, turf, floodlights and concrete stands

coverage_missing.ask: Is the lobby a room on the same map as the pitch, or a separate place?
Does the pitch shrink for smaller team sizes, or is it one size for every mode?
You said no bots and then asked for an AI goalkeeper - should there be any AI on the pitch besides the keeper?

answers.ask: Full regulation pitch, or a smaller arcade-sized one that suits 1v1 as well as 5v5?
answers.answer: Use a smaller arcade-sized pitch so every listed mode, especially 1v1 through 5v5, stays fast and playable in five-minute matches.

answers.ask: Is the lobby part of the same map as the pitch, or a separate place the mode boxes teleport out of?
answers.answer: Make the lobby a separate place, with the mode boxes teleporting players into their selected match.

answers.ask: A real-looking stadium, or something more stylized?
answers.answer: Use a real-looking soccer stadium theme.
